Then both routes start from the same embeddings up to declared quantization, and endpoint divergence arises at or after the first in-graph operation. This does NOT identify a layer.

predictions.reported_regardless: Per-element and per-row difference distributions in declared units, worst rows/IDs, and the exact fraction outside budget. No pass or fail quality verdict.

stop_criterion: Stop immediately on any binding, size, hash or dtype failure. Otherwise stop after ONE bounded packet, whatever the outcome. No variant, no second boundary, no repeated reconstruction, no automatic follow-up.

execution_envelope_if_authorized.reads: Static embedding tables and captured input payloads only

declared_transform_source: Pinned LUT provenance, pinned source quantization code revision and the recorded export-boundary contract; nothing fitted to QNN outputs.
